title: Anonymous Rebuttal Dashboard
subtitle: Sanitized demo data for an evidence-backed rebuttal review loop

issues.title: Protocol separation
issues.summary: Separate deployable claims from calibrated diagnostics.
issues.risk: Do not cite calibrated rows as no-label evidence.

issues.title: Private process leakage
issues.summary: Remove local paths, AI/tool traces, and strategy wording before public submission.
issues.risk: Private workflow details can make the AC distrust the response.

issues.title: Unbounded deployment claim
issues.summary: Constrain deployment language to the evaluated protocol and named baselines.
issues.risk: Avoid production-ready claims without deployment evidence.

issues.title: Cost evidence
issues.summary: Report memory class, latency baseline, and route ratio.
issues.risk: Frame as an accuracy-cost trade-off, not universal speedup.

issues.title: Mechanism attribution
issues.summary: Show that the gain is not only from a stronger component.

issues.title: Revision promises
issues.summary: Each promise names a table, caption, appendix, or artifact.

issues.title: Weak-case framing
issues.summary: Diagnose negative cases without inventing new evidence.

issues.title: Table-caption clarity
issues.summary: Make strict, diagnostic, and sensitivity rows visually distinct.
issues.risk: Dense captions can blur protocol boundaries.

issues.title: Reviewer coverage map
issues.summary: All reviewer-specific objections have visible response anchors.
issues.risk: Keep reviewer IDs anonymized in public demos.

issues.title: Final response box
issues.summary: Check platform word and character budgets before paste-in submission.
issues.risk: Avoid unsupported LaTeX commands in final text boxes.

reviewers.stance: Concerned about weak cases and broader use.
Wants the revision plan to be auditable.
